meta.descricao: Crosswords, word search, sudoku, hangman, memory, tic-tac-toe with questions and dictation built from the glossary and the lessons; music games for children; and the training games (Rumos, Strike!). No points, no leaderboard, no account.

pagina.lead: Games to practise the words from the lessons, to play with music and to decide paths in history. None has points, a leaderboard or a daily streak: when it ends, it ends. Nothing you do here leaves your device.
pagina.aviso: The word games use the institute's glossary, which is in Portuguese.

treino.lead: Generated on the spot from the glossary terms and the lessons where they appear. Every game is new.

cruzadas.texto: The clues are the glossary definitions.

caca.texto: Find the hidden terms in the grid.

forca.texto: Guess the term before the flower loses its petals.

memoria.texto: Match each term with its definition.

quebra.texto: Put the letters or the words in order.

velha.texto: To mark a square, answer the question.

comum.terminou: Done! Start another if you like.
comum.semPontos: No points: this is for practice.

cruzadas.instrucao: Type letters in the squares. Arrow keys move between squares; Tab moves to the next word.
cruzadas.faltam: Some squares are wrong or empty. Wrong ones are marked.
cruzadas.semPalavras: The crossword could not be built right now. Try a new game.

caca.instrucao: Tap the first letter and then the last letter of each word. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys and Enter.
caca.inicio: Start marked at {r}, {c}. Choose the last letter.
caca.tentou: That line is not one of the words.

sudoku.instrucao: Each row, column and block holds every number once. Choose a square and a number.
sudoku.repetidos: Some numbers repeat; they are marked.
sudoku.dicaFeita: One square was filled in for you.

forca.instrucao: Choose letters. Each mistake drops a petal of the flower; it has 6.
forca.ganhou: The flower is standing! The term is {termo}.
forca.perdeu: The flower lost its petals. The term was {termo}.

memoria.instrucao: Flip two cards: a term and its definition make a pair.

quebra.instrucaoLetras: Put the letters in order to make the term. Hint: the definition, with the term hidden.
quebra.instrucaoFrase: Put the words in order to make the definition of the term.
quebra.errado: Not in the right order yet.

velha.instrucao: To mark a square, answer the question. Wrong: the turn passes.
velha.pergunta: Which term is defined this way?
velha.empate: A draw: nobody made a line.
velha.errou: Not this time. The term was {termo}.

ditado.instrucao: Click Listen, write what you heard and check. The voice is your browser's.
ditado.semVoz: This device has no voice to read aloud. You can see the text and copy it by hand.
ditado.acento: Almost: the letters are right, check accents or punctuation. The right one is: {certa}
ditado.errado: Not yet. The right one is: {certa}

criancas.lead: Sounds made on the device itself, nothing to download. No points, no timer and no failing: if the melody comes out different, we listen again. Better with an adult nearby.
criancas.semAudio: This device cannot play the game sounds.

piano.texto: Tap the coloured keys and listen.

melodia.texto: Listen to the notes and play them in the same order.

bateria.texto: Hit the drums or listen to a ready beat.

iguais.texto: Find the pairs of matching sounds.

altoBaixo.texto: Listen to two sounds and say which is higher.

criancas.muitoBem: Well done! You played the whole melody.
criancas.fimMelodia: That is enough melodies for now. How about another activity?
criancas.doisSons: Tap to hear the two sounds.
criancas.agudoCerto: Yes! The higher sound is the thinner one.
criancas.agudoErrado: Not this time. Listen again and compare.

proprios.lead: Sixteen games the institute made itself, about work, rights, public money, fake news, the city, health, electricity, sewing and computers. Each one has its sources and ends: no points pile up and there is no daily streak.
proprios.aviso: These games are only in Portuguese.

grupo.lead: To study together, 2 to 12 people, each on their own device. Whoever creates the room gets a short code; the others join with it and a nickname. No account, and nothing is stored: the room disappears when everyone leaves.

corrida.texto: Questions from the lessons, by subject: whoever answers right first earns more.

mutirao.texto: Teams discuss, and each team counts with its most voted answer.

quem-disse.nome: Who said it? in a circle
quem-disse.texto: One quote, four names. The circle finds out who said it.

fato-ou-boato.nome: Fact or hoax? in a circle
fato-ou-boato.texto: Claims from the site's fact-checks: fact, hoax or misleading?

assembleia.texto: Debate with a vote: secret opinion, unsigned arguments, vote for the strongest and a second opinion.

forca.texto: One letter at a time, each in their turn. The group saves the word together.

bingo.texto: A definition is called; whoever has the concept on their card marks it. Full line: bingo!

fio.texto: Cards with historical facts: the group votes where each one goes on the timeline.

entrada.criarTexto: You host the room: choose the game and move the rounds forward. You can play too or just present on a big screen.
entrada.entrarTexto: Type the code the room's creator gave you.
entrada.apelidoAjuda: Up to 20 letters. Don't use your full name, phone number or social media.
entrada.codigoInvalido: The code has 5 letters and numbers (no 0, O, 1, I or L).
entrada.apelidoInvalido: That nickname won't do: pick another one, without contact details.
entrada.naoAchou: We couldn't find that room. Check the code or ask its creator for a new one.
entrada.falhou: Couldn't connect. Check your internet and try again.
entrada.soNesteNavegador: This copy of the site has no real-time service: the room only works between tabs of this browser.
entrada.privacidade: How it works: the room goes through the site's own real-time channel. Only the nickname and the moves travel; nothing goes into a database, and the room disappears when everyone leaves.

sala.esperando: Waiting for the host to choose the game and start.
sala.poucos: You can test it alone; it's better with more people.
sala.semConteudo: Couldn't build the match with that content. Choose another.
sala.pontosDaPartida: Points for this match only: they vanish when the room ends.

partida.espere: Answer sent. Wait for the reveal.
partida.apresentando: You are only presenting: answers show up here.

debate.pergunta: What do you think of this statement?
debate.escreva: Write an argument (up to 2 per person, without your name)
debate.vote: Vote for the strongest argument (yours doesn't count).
debate.votou: Vote recorded. You can change it until voting ends.
debate.mudou: And now? After the arguments, has your opinion changed?

bingo.marque: Mark the concept if it is on your card.
bingo.semCartela: You are only presenting: cards belong to the players.

fio.carta: Where does this card go on the timeline?
fio.acertou: The group got it! It was in {ano}.

fim.placar: Who scored most in this match
fim.esperando: The host chooses the next game.
